historical_reviews.deepseek: Treats MPIO as a generic firmware fault without target-specific interface evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds operator control and tuple preservation but does not define the functional blast radius of errormode3.
historical_reviews.related_cases: MP5 row 84 uses errormode2 with CCD0; MPIO UCE row 86 uses the same mode3/index0 with errortype1. The CE must retain a distinct no-reset/no-service-impact oracle.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A correctable management-processor I/O fault requires vendor block decoding and health checks for the interfaces actually owned by that block.

original_test_intent: Inject one correctable error in the platform-defined MPIO block, verify an exact fresh corrected report without reset or UCE escalation, and demonstrate that every MPIO-owned interface and dependent service remains functional.
original_method: Obtain the vendor MPIO definition and interface ownership map; validate mode3/index0/socket coverage; capture raw settings, counters and service baselines; inject once; correlate exactly one MPIO-specific CE; check no reset/UCE; exercise only approved non-destructive interface transactions; restore RAS/HDT state and compare health.
manual_activity: The FAE identifies the MPIO block and owned interfaces, approves mode3/index0, performs one CE injection, observes dependent services and restores all platform settings.
required_inputs: Authoritative expansion/definition of MPIO and its firmware block, interfaces and service dependencies
Vendor semantics for smupsp errormode3, enablemcapolling0, errorindex0 and errortype0
Socket/package coverage and whether index0 maps to one or multiple interfaces
FFE threshold and SMU/PSP-debug-disable relevance with raw restore values
Fresh MPIO-specific CE source/severity/count plus explicit no-reset/no-UCE oracle
Supported OS, timeout, interface transaction and service-health limits, aborts and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT with independent OOB access not dependent on the interface under test
Baseline all MPIO-owned interface links, counters and services before injection
Use a non-destructive isolated transaction for health checking and inject once
Abort on reset, UCE, management-path loss, interface link/counter anomaly, service failure or wrong source
No automatic retry; restore settings and confirm all dependent paths return to baseline
agent_execution_scope: Validate MPIO identity, interface ownership, tuple, CE oracle and recovery plan
Collect read-only raw settings, exact event fields, interface counters and dependent service health
Do not infer interfaces, choose index/socket, alter BIOS/HDT, inject, reset, recover, retry or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve MPIO definition, interface map and tuple
Approve CE/no-impact evidence and isolated health transaction

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic SMU/MPIO grep cannot establish which MPIO-owned interface errorindex0 represents, count a fresh CE or detect silent service degradation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After vendor mapping, inject one mode3/index0 CE and correlate an exact MPIO event with no reset/UCE plus unchanged link, counter, transaction and service behavior.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: socket0, errormode3, enablemcapolling0, errorindex0, errortype0, FFE threshold, three OS families and 15/10-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one source-identified MPIO CE with exactly-one-event/no-reset acceptance and before/after interface-service validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds MPIO definition, owned-interface coverage, event count, negative escalation and functional dependency checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS and a generic corrected line cannot show that the intended I/O block was hit or that its clients remained usable.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unknown MPIO ownership means the blast radius may include management or platform I/O needed for recovery.

project_override_considerations: If MPIO controls the only management path, establish an independent recovery channel before execution. Do not equate MPIO with Linux multipath I/O or another familiar acronym without the vendor specification.
expected_evidence: Vendor MPIO block/interface/service map and approved tuple semantics
Raw BIOS/HDT, error-counter, interface and service baseline
Exact injection transcript and no-reset timeline
Exactly one fresh MPIO-specific CE MCA/CPER/WHEA/SEL record with zero UCE delta
Stable interface links/counters, isolated transactions and dependent services

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The CE title, errortype0 and applicable tool-PASS branch align. The source is incomplete about the MPIO identity, tuple semantics and functional acceptance, but it does not assert a competing target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The literal MPIO CE operation is identifiable and the missing vendor map is a normal execution prerequisite. Static review can complete without guessing its expansion.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 85 Wistron-System RAS-00805-V003: define the platform MPIO block and every owned interface/service; prove smupsp errormode3/enablemcapolling0/errorindex0/errortype0 semantics and socket coverage; specify FFE/debug relevance, exact fresh CE/no-reset/no-UCE fields, OS timeout, isolated interface transactions and dependent-service health limits, independent recovery path, aborts and restoration.

review_improvement: Prevents the undefined MPIO acronym from being treated as generic firmware logging and adds interface/service evidence tied to the actual block.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source encodes MPIO only through errormode3, so its affected interfaces cannot be inferred from Linux terminology or adjacent MP5 cases. A controller may correct an internal error yet leave a link or dependent service degraded. Acceptance therefore needs vendor ownership mapping, an exact fresh CE and non-destructive checks of the specific interfaces, with recovery independent of the tested path.
